name: nipoppy-cli
description: Nipoppy skill toolbox, split by command class rather than by verb: nipoppy-query reads state and changes nothing, nipoppy-track refreshes the derived status files and hands the save back, nipoppy-compute constructs the commands that produce data and refuses to execute them, and nipoppy-setup scaffolds a dataset and its pipeline configurations. The split is the safety property: nipoppy records nothing about how derivatives came to be, so a computation executed bare produces a tree nothing can re-derive.
